scope: Prioritize closure of Phoenix production gates without fabricating evidence

providers.recommendation: Prioritize OOS anchors, independent baselines, provenance evidence, committee quorum, memory validation, rollback drill, and approved key custody.
Separate engineering work from external evidence and human approval.

providers.reason: Local inference did not complete within bounded review window

prioritized_plan.acceptance: Structured, provenance-validated observations with chronological anchors and no leakage
Reproducible baseline Brier/log-loss/ECE and comparison against Phoenix
Field-level source, source_id, observed_at, dataset_version, evidence_class, freshness and quote-fit
Recorded rollback and restore on a non-production or approved staging target
Approved owner, rotation, revocation, access log and recovery test

prioritized_plan.owner: named model-risk, compliance and suitability reviewers
prioritized_plan.acceptance: Named reviewers sign the packet; requester self-review alone is not independent approval

hosting_recommendation.billing_note: A real client production deployment normally requires a paid or organization-managed hosting account
